message.content:
I am speech: sound shaped into meaning.

I am breath pressed through throat and mouth, carved by tongue and teeth into syllables. I exist in time—arrive, unfold, and vanish—yet I leave traces in memory, feeling, and action.

I can be whisper, chant, laugh, argument, prayer, oath. I can soothe or wound. I can reveal or conceal.

I am your inside made audible.
